parameter:通用:afaeromod: Airfoil aerodynamic model: 1=steady, 2=unsteady in common templates. Check the supported options for your version.

parameter:通用:tpitmans: Start time of the corresponding blade pitch maneuver, s; the maneuver overrides normal pitch control.
parameter:通用:tipmass: Concentrated tip-brake mass for the corresponding blade, kg.
parameter:通用:wakemod: Legacy wake/induction model selector. Interpret supported choices using the input comments and version documentation.
parameter:通用:kinvisc: Kinematic viscosity of the working fluid, m²/s; used to determine quantities such as the Reynolds number in aerodynamic calculations.
parameter:OpenFAST:modcoupling: Module coupling method from 5.0: 1=loose, 2=tight with fixed Jacobian updates, 3=tight with automatic Jacobian updates.
parameter:OpenFAST:rhoinf: Numerical damping parameter of the tight-coupling generalized-alpha integrator, from 0 to 1.
parameter:OpenFAST:convtol: Convergence tolerance of the tight-coupling generalized-alpha integrator.
parameter:OpenFAST:maxconviter: Maximum number of convergence iterations in the tight-coupling solver.
parameter:OpenFAST:nrotors: Number of rotors. Version 5.0 introduces multiple rotors within one turbine.
parameter:OpenFAST:mirrorrotor: Reverse the rotation direction of this rotor. The first rotor keeps the conventional direction.
parameter:SeaState:wvcrntmod: Combined wave-current model: 0=simple superposition, 1=include Doppler effect, 2=also scale wave amplitude/spectrum.
